object: A17 u at bit 29 (dA17 = e0000000): other signed patterns
question: Do the other signed patterns of dA17 = e0000000 (weight<=6: 3 alternatives) reach the same later differences and the 38-step event?
number: Patterns (sdiff): u29 [printed, Pr 2^-1], u30 n29, n31 n30 n29, u31 n30 n29. Window, 4 seeds (2^27 samples): u30n29 prefix log2P -90.57 vs base -84.98 (cost 5.59 bit), EXACT 5334 vs 5230, event weight 0.0212 of base; n31n30n29 prefix -96.79 (cost 11.81 bit), EXACT 5341, weight 0.00028; u31n30n29 dead at stage 18 (2 seeds). backward rows 17..25: needed-X probability product 1/32, 1/1024, 1/1024 of base (rows 18A, 19A, 20A change); rows 21..25 unchanged. So u30n29 and n31n30n29 reach the same later differences and the same event rate once the prefix holds, at a prefix cost of about 5.6 and 11.8 bits; u31n30n29 not reached in 2 seeds.
notes: Universe cell sha256-38|r17|A|Q4. Union of printed + alternatives would add event weight 0.0212+0.0003 = +0.031 bit at most (SMC prefix noise about 0.3 bit per seed); not a lever. Method: variant chi38 file per alternative (work/chi/*.txt, generated by work/gen.py from chi/chi38.txt; every other line unchanged), traillab window --rows 22 37 --event out --no-elist --autolist --np 4096 --mt 8192 --threads 3, seeds 9301,9302 (and 9303,9304 where an alternative stayed alive); unmodified chi38 reproduces atlas_runs38/H-drops/out/base.txt bit for bit on seeds 9301,9302 (work/out/_regression_base.txt: EXACT 1320/1265, prefix -84.995/-85.055). 'dead' = the SMC stage accepted 0 of 1,048,576 proposals on each seed. Window/prefix model only (no full-path check).
